messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — anomalous smart-routing hits observed. 503 fallback loop + cache reuse across model variants in region us-west-2. Potential customer-facing incorrect responses. Alert: 90% of fallbacks in last 10m are to older-opt model. monitor: https://console.redwood/alerts/INC-452

oncall-sre: acked. I'm pulling logs now. pinging priya and alex for routing config check. what's current rollout policy?

alex.k: seeing repeated entries where KV key is built without model_variant suffix. sample request_id=req_97531; cached_value.variant=redwood-3b-opt, incoming route.explicit=redwood-1. Evidence of prefix being only user_id+prompthash.

priya: omg that explains the weird semantics customers reported. looks like an earlier change to caching layer (PR #4232) defaulted to legacy keying. rolling back that PR now.

julian: in the meantime we should stop fallback->variant routing. propose a temporary policy toggle: `routing.fallback.enabled=false` for hosted tier. that'll force hard failures instead of silent reuse.

oncall-sre: doing that now. `opsctl config set routing.fallback.enabled false --scope=hosted --confirm` -> applied. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Command executed by oncall-sre at 2026-03-15T14:18:22Z: routing.fallback.enabled set to false for scope=hosted.

emily: customer-ops — which customers saw bad outputs? we need to open support tickets.

customer-ops: Support report from AcmeCorp and Starlight. They saw hallucinations and inconsistent completions for retrieval prompts. Estimated window 14:05–14:20 UTC. I've created tickets #SUP-988 and #SUP-989 and notified account reps.

alex.k: flushing affected KV prefixes in us-west-2. commands:
```
# list keys (prefix)
redis-cli -h kv-usw2 keys "cache:prompt:*"
# delete only keys without model suffix
redis-cli -h kv-usw2 --scan --pattern "cache:prompt:*" | grep -v "-model-" | xargs -r redis-cli -h kv-usw2 del
```
Started deletion job (async). May take ~3-5m.

priya: rollback PR #4232 merged and promoted to canary -> all endpoints will use model-aware cache keying going forward. Patch note: add `:model` suffix to prefix building.

julian: monitoring traces show error rate drop after disabling fallback + flush. dashboard: https://console.redwood/metrics/dashboards/routing

oncall-sre: updating incident severity. initially P1 due to customer impact, now P2. continuing to monitor for 30m before closing. creating postmortem stub: https://confluence.redwood/INC-452

emily: drafting customer comms: we'll include root cause, mitigation, and steps to avoid recurrence. ETA for note: 30m. cc @customer-ops.

alex.k: one more action: add an automated test for cache keying in e2e routing suite. filing ticket RT-1124.

priya: handoff to next on-call in 40m. leaving runbook steps and links in the incident doc. thanks all.

oncall-sre: handing off to @julian for overnight watch. Please escalate to SRE lead if error rate reverts. :lock:
